items.meta_title: Use a Premium Code on iPhone, iPad and Mac | VpnHood!
items.meta_description: On Apple devices you don't enter a premium code in VpnHood! CONNECT. Here is why, and how your code reaches your iPhone, iPad or Mac through your account.
items.page_title: Use a premium code on iPhone, iPad and Mac
items.page_desc: On Apple devices you don't enter your premium code in the app. It reaches your iPhone, iPad or Mac through your VpnHood! account, in a couple of minutes.
items.hero_alt: One glowing key reaching a MacBook, an iPad and an iPhone, each showing the premium crown
items.why_desc: Apple lets an App Store app unlock paid features only through Apple's own in-app purchase, not with a premium code. So VpnHood! CONNECT on iPhone, iPad and Mac has no box for one. Apple does let an app honour a plan you got elsewhere once you sign in, so your code reaches your Apple devices through your account.
items.how_title: Add your code through your account
items.step1: Sign in and enter your premium code in one of these places:
items.step1_device: in VpnHood! CONNECT on another device, such as an Android phone or a Windows PC;
items.step2: On your iPhone, iPad or Mac, sign in to VpnHood! CONNECT with the same account. The app shows You are premium.
